description: This file defines data structures, constants, and a singleton class related to device-side assertions and kernel launch tracking in CUDA for PyTorch. It includes structures for assertion data, kernel launch info, and a registry class for managing kernel launches and assertions, facilitating debugging and error tracking on GPU devices.

classes.name: CUDAKernelLaunchRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing kernel launch information and device assertions, providing thread-safe registration, snapshot, and assertion retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Registers a new kernel launch and returns a unique generation number.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns copies of current kernel launch info and device assertions for inspection.

methods.name: get_uvm_assertions_ptr_for_current_device
methods.description: Provides a pointer to the current device's assertion buffer, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: get_singleton_ref
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry.

methods.name: has_failed
methods.description: Indicates if any device has reported a failure.
